name: KromiumJsBridge
summary: Facade for JavaScript execution, DOM evaluation, and text extraction.

methods.name: executeJavaScript
methods.description: Executes arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the current page.

methods.name: evaluateJavaScript
methods.signature: suspend fun evaluateJavaScript(expression: String, timeoutMs: Long? = null, bindingTimeoutMs: Long? = null, bindingIntervalMs: Long? = null): String?
methods.description: Executes arbitrary JavaScript asynchronously and returns the stringified response.

parameters.name: bindingTimeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum time in ms to poll for the query router function.

parameters.name: bindingIntervalMs
parameters.description: Polling interval in ms between router binding checks.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Convenience function to fetch the complete HTML of the current document (document.documentElement.outerHTML).

methods.name: getHtmlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the complete HTML of the current document.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Convenience function to fetch the visible text content of the current document (document.body.innerText).

methods.name: getTextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the visible text content of the current document.

methods.name: getFaviconUrl
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the URL of the page's favicon using DOM inspection.
